verdict.rationale: The only first-party scaling evidence is a Cloud marketing claim of read high availability with native clusterization, plus Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment. Self-hosting docs describe a single binary with no external dependencies, and no documented clustering or replication path appears for self-hosted deployments. Community reports show one node handling about 80M documents across 13 indexes, but others hit unpredictable RAM use on large datasets, indexing that fell hours behind, and trouble scaling writes. missing for 10: documented self-hosted clustering/replication/sharding guides, write high availability, evidence of a path to hundreds of millions of documents, independent corroboration of Cloud HA clustering.
